notes: max_attempts is what an order may cost us in evaluated attempts. The rating vendor bills per attempt: the July invoice charged 4181 attempts for 1902 orders, and finance asked for a cap once they had matched that line against the orders we priced.
step_budget is per order. It exists because the September lane comprehension in tier_pricing held the run open until 09:40 and nobody could tell which rule was doing it.

max_open_leases is per order. The rating vendor charges by the hour for every reservation held, from the moment it is opened until it is given back, and refuses a second concurrent one for the same order at renewal time.
on_error and retry_on_error were added in June with the rest of the rulebook fields. The engine has carried them ever since; nothing has used them yet.

depot_reweigh and manual_reweigh went in with the August depot changes. A re-weighed order is priced from the rating vendor's rate and the order's fourth line; an order the depot could not read that line on goes to a manual re-check, which reserves rating capacity of its own, and the closing branch reserves the settlement slot the close is written into.
